subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw add `parseJsonlEvent` plus its normalized event union as a supported long-lived public `CliBackendPlugin` API, rather than keeping provider-specific JSONL parsing limited to existing built-in dialects?
rationale: The patch is an opt-in public SDK expansion, not a repair to an established plugin contract; choosing its permanent API shape and support commitment requires owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook
options.body: Approve the optional parser hook as the canonical plugin boundary, contingent on a clean rebase and real external-plugin proof.

options.title: Keep JSONL parser ownership internal
options.body: Decline the new public API and leave third-party JSONL integrations on existing supported plugin seams or a future owner-designed contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook
recommendation.body: Approve the optional parser hook as the canonical plugin boundary, contingent on a clean rebase and real external-plugin proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI-backend contract history and adjacent architecture changes make @steipete the best available owner for the public-API direction.
